message: Analytics sheets that group by name no longer show a category twice. Where a district's catalog held two capitalizations of the same entry (for example "Issue Not Listed" and "Issue not listed"), the sheet printed two rows whose every number was the combined total of both, inflating the column total. This affected issue categories, issue types, device models, teams, locations, priorities and technicians. Re-create the affected analytics sheets, or copy the current template, to pick up the fix.
